author: Vigors, 1831
summary: 2021년과 2024년 5월 서해 백령도에서 관찰된 길잃은새로, 국내 기록이 10건이 안 된다. 히말라야에서 중국 서부·서남부에 걸친 높은 고원과 산지에서 번식하고, 겨울에는 산기슭과 평지로 내려와 지낸다. 덤불이나 작은 나무 꼭대기에 눈에 띄게 앉아 있다가 땅으로 내려와 곤충 같은 작은 무척추동물을 잡는다.

points.ko: 부리 위 이마의 가는 검은 띠
points.en: narrow black band on the forehead just above the bill
black mask through the lores and eye to the ear-coverts
uniform dark grey crown, nape, mantle and back

young: 어린새는 어른새보다 칙칙하고 이마의 검은 띠가 없으며 귀깃이 짙은 갈색이다. 아랫면은 희끄무레한 바탕에 갈색 물결 가로무늬가 많고, 위꼬리덮깃에도 가로무늬가 있다.

similar.how: 긴꼬리때까치는 등 아래쪽부터 적갈색이고 날개에 작은 흰 반점이 있으며 꼬리가 검지만, 회색등때까치는 머리부터 등까지 짙은 회색이고 날개에 흰 반점이 없으며 꼬리가 적갈색 띤 갈색이다.

art.subject: Grey-backed Shrike (Lanius tephronotus), adult: forehead, crown, nape, mantle and back dark grey, with at most a thin black line across the forehead at the base of the bill; a broad black mask from the bill through the eye to the ear-coverts; rump and uppertail coverts rufous; wings dark brown without any white patch; chin and throat white; breast, flanks and belly extensively washed warm rufous-orange, palest in the centre of the belly; tail long, dark rufous-brown. Bill black and hooked; dark eye; legs blackish.
art.pose: perched upright on top of a bush, side view
art.scene: Bushy farmland edge on a Korean offshore island in May, during spring migration, bright light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on top of a bush: uniform dark grey crown to back, narrow black band above the bill, black mask through the eye to the ear-coverts, small rufous rump patch, blackish wings with pale-fringed coverts and no white patch, white throat, rufous-orange breast and flanks, long chestnut-brown tail

adult, front three-quarter view perched upright: dark grey crown and back, black mask and narrow black forehead band, white throat, rufous-orange breast and flanks paling on the belly, strong hooked black bill
art.build: Fairly large, long-tailed shrike, clearly larger than Bull-headed Shrike and about the length of a Brown-eared Bulbul; large head and a strong hooked bill shorter than the head. Legs short, dark. Tail long and graduated. The grey of the upperparts runs from the crown down to the lower back, where it meets the rufous rump. Perches upright on bush tops.
avoid: Do not paint a white wing patch, rufous scapulars or a long black tail; those mark Long-tailed Shrike (Lanius schach).
Do not paint white underparts with black wings and white wing-bars (Chinese Grey Shrike, Lanius sphenocercus).
Do not paint a rufous or brown crown.
Do not leave the breast whitish with only a buff tinge at the sides; the breast and flanks are broadly rufous-orange.
